Cardboard-box method to size the bins (q27)
tasks.detail: Pack one 10696 set's floor-1 bricks (149 pieces) into a cardboard box, no bigger than needed to fit them. Do the same for the floor-2 other pieces (335). Record each box's L x W x H and volume. Double each volume to size for 2 sets (earlier note said 2 to 3 sets; confirm which with BJ). Those two doubled volumes become the floor 1 and floor 2 bin targets.
